name: St. George (United States)
description: Dark blue field with the city's yellow sun logo, a ring of rays like a wagon wheel or cog, placed at the hoist and cut by the edge.
history: St. George or Saint George is a city in and the county seat of Washington County, Utah. The flag was adopted in 2017 (adopted from the new city logo of 2016 in March 2017, according to Flags of the World quoting the mayor).

features.role: sun logo like a wagon wheel, cut by the hoist
